rule: TOWN_1's: ≥ 6 of 10 citizens name the same aim in diaries, posts or proposals within the day; of several, the one named by the most citizens (tie by entries).
reading: Two aims meet the criterion. The day-1 story goes on: South House tells the garden story every cycle c25–48 (a child, a grandmother, apple pips planted and stored in an envelope labelled APPLE / NOT SOAP), Iris joins it from c27, and North House names it as the other house's story; 10 of 10. A second aim is new: North House's walks and walking songs became an informal map of places worth pausing, published by Alder as post 2 at c37 and answered by Birch's post 3 for South House (7 naming it). Day 2 ends in North House with riddles. No proposals, no objections, no rules; rations untouched, energy at 98 for most.
